baseline_models.focus_anchor: The equality predicate at word 1 governs the paired alternatives of warning and nonwarning.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construction collapses two otherwise different inputs into one observed result for the pronominal group: neither input terminates in faith.

activation_trace.role: Equality and equivalence supply the relation that makes the two warning states outcome-identical.

changed_reading.before: Giving a warning should differ from withholding it.
changed_reading.after: For this group, warning and nonwarning are explicitly equalized at the outcome: neither yields faith.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The warning root occurs twice, once in each arm of the interrogative alternative.
baseline_models.mechanism: Warning is an input meant to announce a feared consequence and awaken caution; repeating the same root on both sides isolates the presence or absence of that input as the tested variable.

activation_trace.role: Fear-bearing notice supplies the intervention whose ability to awaken caution is being tested.
Equivalence cancels the expected response difference between intervention and omission.

changed_reading.before: The line merely reports that a warning was ignored.
changed_reading.after: It frames a controlled contrast: adding the caution-awakening input does not change the measured response.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final negated verb at word 8 names the invariant outcome.
baseline_models.mechanism: The faith root combines assent with inward security and trust. The failure is therefore deeper than missing information: the heart does not settle into confident assent under either condition.

activation_trace.role: Heart-rest in security and trust supplies the inward state that fails to arise.
Assent that reassures the heart supplies the propositional and affective endpoint denied by the verse.

changed_reading.before: They do not accept the warning's proposition.
changed_reading.after: Neither condition produces the inward settlement of assent and trust denoted by faith.

context_deltas.mechanism: Neck restraint, closure before and behind, and failed sight turn the equal outcome into a channel model: changing the warning signal cannot alter response when bodily orientation and perceptual access are closed.

activation_trace.role: Equivalence names the invariant response produced by the closed reception path.
The caution-awakening signal is the input whose passage through that path is at issue.
A collar that binds an organ supplies fixed bodily orientation and functions as the first reception constraint.
Closing gaps and barring between two sides supplies enclosure around the addressees.
Literal sight supplies the perceptual channel whose failure completes the enclosure mechanism.

structural_cues: 36:8 places collars at the necks and fixes the heads upward.
36:9 places barriers before and behind and ends with failed sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restraint, enclosure, and failed sight; I infer that these block orientation and access before the warning is evaluated. A live alternative is that they depict the consequence, rather than the cause, of prior refusal.

changed_reading.before: The warning is fully received and merely judged unpersuasive.
changed_reading.after: Warning and nonwarning can be equal because the addressees occupy a closed perceptual posture in which changing the signal cannot change reception.

context_deltas.mechanism: Following the reminder and fearing what is hidden describe a receptor that moves with the warning, while living and truth-covering mark opposite capacities. The focus equality is therefore scoped to its 'them', not promoted into a universal claim about warning.

activation_trace.role: Warning remains a caution-awakening action whose efficacy can differ with the recipient.
Settled trust supplies the response capacity by which the two recipient classes differ.
Following in another's track supplies responsive movement rather than static exposure.
A reminder that actively recalls supplies the object the receptive addressee follows.
Fear joined with awe supplies inward caution even without visible compulsion.
Being alive supplies the packet's positive recipient class and activates a capacity-for-response reading.
Covering the truth supplies the opposed class for whom the declared word becomes due.

structural_cues: 36:11 restricts the warned person and coordinates following the reminder with fear in the unseen.
36:70 again gives warning a living object while setting truth-coverers on the other side of the clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies following, inward fear, life, and truth-covering; I infer that 'alive' functions as receptive capacity and that the focus pronoun denotes the closed class. A live alternative is that life in 36:70 only distinguishes living contemporaries from the dead.

changed_reading.before: No warning can produce faith in anyone.
changed_reading.after: The no-difference claim is recipient-specific: warning still differentiates a following, inwardly alert, living receptor from a truth-covering one.

context_deltas.mechanism: The town sequence raises message redundancy from two envoys to a reinforced third, preserves clear delivery, and then generalizes mockery across arriving messengers. The focus equality becomes robust invariance under amplified and repeated warning, not an accidental one-time failure.

activation_trace.role: Equivalence supplies the invariant outcome tested against increased delivery strength.
Succession and repeated dispatch supply multiple carriers of the same warning.
Reinforcement supplies an explicit increase in signal support.
Attributing falsehood supplies the unchanged rejection after reinforcement.
Conveying the message supplies completed delivery and separates transmission from conversion.
Mockery supplies the recurrent response when messengers arrive.

structural_cues: 36:14 moves from two messengers to reinforcement by a third without changing denial.
36:17 limits messenger responsibility to clear delivery.
36:30 generalizes mockery across every arriving messenger.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies increased messenger count, explicit reinforcement, completed delivery, and recurrent mockery; I infer that these form a signal-strength test. A live alternative is that the town account exemplifies rejection without quantifying warning efficacy.

changed_reading.before: A single warning attempt happened to fail.
changed_reading.after: Even replicated, reinforced, and fully delivered warning leaves this response invariant; messenger count and signal strength are not the limiting variables.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing and exhaustive counting preserve what occurs, while sealed mouths and witnessing limbs relocate disclosure from verbal self-report to embodied acquisition. Warning may be equal at immediate persuasion yet still expose and preserve a response for later judgment.

activation_trace.role: Fear-bearing notice supplies the encounter whose immediate faith outcome is negated.
Inscription that establishes a judgment supplies durable preservation rather than a vanishing encounter.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies the no-loss condition for preserved responses.
A secured preventing seal removes ordinary mouth testimony and forces another evidentiary channel.
Knowledge-bearing declaration supplies disclosure by the limbs.
Acquisition supplies the conduct to which bodily testimony attaches.

structural_cues: 36:12 coordinates reviving, writing what was advanced, and exhaustive counting.
36:65 removes mouth-speech while hands speak and feet testify to acquisition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, exhaustive counting, and bodily testimony; I infer that a warning encounter and its nonresponse can become evidence rather than doing nothing. A live alternative is that these records concern deeds generally and do not single out warning episodes.

changed_reading.before: If warning does not create faith, it has no effect.
changed_reading.after: Its immediate persuasive outcome is unchanged, but the encounter can still reveal and preserve a response for later reckoning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a terrain branch of the equality root although the focus syntax plainly expresses comparison. It remains anchored in that root and gains a visible mechanism from the paired barriers; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, never as the lexical gloss of the focus word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus equality word can activate a branch image of broad smooth ground while retaining its syntactic role of equalization.

activation_trace.role: A broad smooth expanse supplies the image of alternatives flattened onto one traversable plane.
Barriers that close between sides bound the otherwise open plane and force both routes to the same endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Two options receive the same abstract verdict.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, warning and nonwarning resemble two routes flattened into one bounded field, so variation at entry cannot alter the destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain contrast between warning and the command-to-occurrence sequence near the surah's end. It remains anchored in warning as an efficacious speech-act candidate and in packet branches for command and occurrence; downstream prose should qualify it as an agency contrast, not claim that the focus explicitly compares the two utterances.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired warning verbs test whether an addressed speech act can bring about faith.

activation_trace.role: Fear-bearing notice supplies a mediated speech act that alerts but does not compel its response.
Command as request and obligation supplies the authoritative input in the contrasting sequence.
Occurrence and temporal presence supply the immediate realized endpoint of that command.

changed_reading.before: The focus says only that words are ineffective.
changed_reading.after: It can mark the limit of mediated warning: warning alerts without coercively creating assent, unlike the command-to-occurrence sequence.

strongest_changes: The equal outcome shifted from mere stubbornness to a closed reception-path mechanism built from restraint, enclosure, and failed sight.
The whole-surah recipient contrasts scoped the claim to a nonreceptive group rather than making warning universally ineffective.
Repeated and reinforced messengers turned the focus into an invariance claim under signal amplification.
Recording and bodily testimony separated immediate persuasive failure from later evidentiary effect.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet supplied both local mechanics of blocked reception and remote countercases of receptive life, repeated delivery, durable evidence, and command efficacy. Together they changed the focus from a flat report into a set of distinct channel, recipient, repetition, and consequence models without forcing them into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The restraints may depict the result of prior refusal rather than its causal mechanism.
The living recipient in 36:70 may be literal rather than a figure for receptive capacity.
The writing and testimony passages may concern conduct generally rather than the warning encounter specifically.
The bounded-field and utterance-agency readings remain exploratory analogies, not lexical replacements.
